paragraphs.text: Chamberlain Maree is a goblin of the Izzet League on Ravnica . She is Second-in-command to Ral Zarek and leader of the Izzet League mech-mages.
Early on, Maree came close to exposing the existence of planeswalkers as part of Project Lightning Bug . After they were revealed, she was Ral's second-in-command during the War of the Spark .

After the War, she became acting guildmaster of the Izzet in Ral's absence and simultaneously became acting Deputy to the Living Guildpact , Niv-Mizzet . She unsuccessfully tried to depose Ral, but retained her position.
